verdict.rationale: Trello documents a first-party MCP server ("Connect Trello to any AI tool"), so agents can share Trello boards and cards as a common workspace. It also captures details from email and Slack into its Inbox, views Jira work in a list, and exposes webhooks, which gives some cross-tool flow. None of this documents a handoff mechanism that preserves full context or state between agents or tools. missing for 10: an explicit agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff workflow, documented guarantees that context and history carry over, details of the MCP server's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information
